description: Supabase DB setup, Authentication system, Auth middleware, Profile management, Database seed script, and RLS policies. This covers Tier 1 items #1-5 and #10. Since we have no real Supabase instance, this implements the code infrastructure: Prisma migrations SQL files, RLS policy SQL, working auth flows that gracefully degrade when Supabase is not configured, functional middleware that protects routes when auth is available, and a profile page that works with localStorage fallback.
steps: Create prisma/migrations/0001_initial/migration.sql with the full schema DDL derived from prisma/schema.prisma (all 22 models, indexes, enums). This is manual SQL since we cannot run prisma migrate without a real DB.

Create prisma/migrations/0002_rls_policies/migration.sql with RLS policies: enable RLS on all user-owned tables (users, notes, question_attempts, question_sessions, progress, study_streaks, exam_targets, flashcards, mistake_logs, question_bookmarks, note_bookmarks, resource_bookmarks, page_bookmarks). Each policy should allow SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only where user_id = auth.uid(). Add a policy for questions/content_resources/subjects/etc that are read-only for all authenticated users.

Create prisma/migrations/0003_search_indexes/migration.sql with GIN indexes for full-text search: add tsvector columns to notes, questions, topics, readings, content_resources tables. Create GIN indexes on those columns. Create trigger functions that auto-update the tsvector on INSERT/UPDATE.
Update src/shared/lib/prisma/client.ts to handle the case where DATABASE_URL is not set gracefully (return a null-like proxy or throw meaningful error only when actually called).

Update src/middleware.ts to implement real auth middleware: check Supabase session, redirect unauthenticated users to /sign-in for protected routes, redirect authenticated users away from /sign-in and /sign-up to /dashboard. Keep the graceful bypass when Supabase is not configured (return NextResponse.next()).
Update src/features/auth/actions/sign-up.ts to create a User record in the database after Supabase auth signup succeeds (using prisma.user.create with authUserId, displayName, level from form).
Update src/features/auth/actions/sign-in.ts - already works, just verify it handles null supabase client.
Create src/features/auth/hooks/use-user.ts - a client-side hook that checks Supabase session and returns user info, falling back to localStorage profile when Supabase is not configured.
Create src/features/auth/hooks/use-session.ts - a hook for session state management.
Update src/app/(protected)/profile/page.tsx to use a real profile form that calls the updateProfile server action, with localStorage fallback.
Update src/features/auth/actions/update-profile.ts to persist to DB when available, fall back to localStorage.

Expand prisma/seed.ts to include Reading and Topic records for each Subject (at least 2-3 readings per subject with 2-3 topics each), making the hierarchy complete: Level -> Subject -> Reading -> Topic.
Ensure all auth components (sign-in-form, sign-up-form, reset-password-form, profile-form) work correctly with the server actions and show proper validation errors.
acceptance_criteria: prisma/migrations/ directory contains 3 SQL migration files with valid PostgreSQL DDL
Middleware correctly routes: unauthenticated users to /sign-in, authenticated users away from auth pages to /dashboard, passes through when Supabase not configured
Auth actions handle null Supabase client gracefully with user-friendly error messages
Profile page renders and allows editing display name and level with localStorage persistence
Seed script contains full hierarchy data (Level -> Subject -> Reading -> Topic) for Level I
npm run test passes (existing + any new tests)
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
findings: 1. src/generated/prisma/ is gitignored but the build needs a module there. Created a stub client.ts with Proxy-based PrismaClient that throws meaningful errors when methods are called without a real DB. Force-added via git add -f. 2. The tsconfig excludes src/generated and src/shared/lib/prisma from type checking, but dynamic imports from non-excluded files still pull them in for analysis. The stub resolves this. 3. Auth actions use dynamic import() for prisma to avoid pulling the module into the type-check graph at the top level. 4. The react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint rule required restructuring hooks to use inline async functions in useEffect instead of calling useCallback-wrapped functions. 5. All 263 existing tests pass, build completes successfully.
